# Description of the Issue
A clear and concise description of what’s wrong or what you want to achieve.  
_Ex._ “When I click **Save**, the form clears but nothing is sent to the server.”

# Goals
What are the objectives of this issue and how will they be solved?  
_Ex._  
- Ensure the form submits its payload to `/api/save-settings`.  
- Show a confirmation toast on success.  
- Validate required fields before sending.

# Describe the Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.  
_Ex._ “On **Save**, run client‑side validation, then POST JSON to the endpoint, and finally display a success notification.”

# Additional Context
Add any other context, logs, screenshots, or links to related issues/PRs.
